Uses of Class
org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.SubProblem

Packages that use SubProblem
Package
Description
org.ddolib.common.cache
This package contains the implementations of cache mechanism.
org.ddolib.common.frontier
This package contains the classes implementing solver frontiers.
org.ddolib.common.mdd
This package contains the classes that are used to implement a restricted/relaxed MDD.
org.ddolib.common.util.verbosity
This package contains util stuff related the verbose mode.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.compilation
This package contains CompilationConfig, which bundles everything needed to compile a layered decision diagram (the CompilationType, dominance checker, cache, cut-set type, clustering strategy, variable heuristic and modeling pieces).
org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.mdd
This package contains LinkedDecisionDiagram, the layered implementation of the shared DecisionDiagram abstraction: a restricted/relaxed MDD compiled layer by layer, together with the Node/Edge/NodeSubProblem classes it is built from.
org.ddolib.layered.util.debug
This package contains util stuff related to the debug mode used only on layered models.
org.ddolib.nolayer.solving.ddo.core.mdd
This package contains NoLayerDecisionDiagram, the no-layer implementation of the shared DecisionDiagram abstraction, which transitions from state to state until a problem-specific target test is met instead of compiling a fixed number of layers.
